data.body: F09 Gerrit patchset 1 failed GitHub run 32605850360 in all four default-suite matrix jobs because the pre-ADR-0049 snapshot documentation contract still required precise legacy HMAC facts. Confirmed the failure locally, compared the contract with ADR 0049, the HMAC removal migration, the F09 scope, origin/main at 04b9c7032371, and maintained signing guidance. Added bounded legacy HMAC-SHA256 and non-repudiation context to docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md while retaining current DSSE and SSHSIG guidance and the rule that legacy records cannot certify current gates. Focused checks passed with 1 snapshot documentation test, 4 reuse-surface tests, 23 signing lifecycle tests, the documentation index check, and git diff --check. The full suite was not run locally.
